title: [04.09] Table - Giờ làm việc của lao động full-time & part-time (2002)
prompt: The tables give information about the average hours work by part-time and full-time men and women in three countries in Europe in 2002 and compare them with the European countries. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
guide:
### 📌 HƯỚNG DẪN TỪNG BƯỚC VIẾT TASK 1 (TRẠM IELTS)

---
### PHẦN 1: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT INTRODUCTION (1 câu)

#### Bước 1: Phân tích đề bài (Xác định 5 yếu tố)
* **1. What (Đối tượng):** Số giờ làm việc trung bình của lao động toàn thời gian (Table 1) và bán thời gian (Table 2) phân theo giới tính.
* **2. Countries (3 quốc gia & Mức chuẩn):** Hy Lạp (Greece), Hà Lan (Netherlands), Vương quốc Anh (UK) so với mức trung bình toàn châu Âu (European average).
* **3. When (Thời gian):** Năm 2002 (in 2002 - biểu đồ tĩnh).
* **4. Unit (Đơn vị đo):** Số giờ mỗi tuần (hours per week).
* **5. Nature (Tính chất):** Hai bảng đối chiếu hai hình thức làm việc.

#### Bước 2: Tìm từ đồng nghĩa (Paraphrasing)
* *The tables give information about the average hours worked* => *The two tables compare the mean weekly working hours*
* *by part-time and full-time men and women* => *of male and female employees in full-time and part-time jobs*
* *in three countries in Europe in 2002* => *in three European nations alongside the continental average in 2002*

#### Bước 3: Công thức và Câu viết hoàn chỉnh
* **Công thức:** `The two tables compare + [the average weekly working hours of full-time and part-time workers] + by gender + in Greece, the Netherlands, and the UK compared to the European average in 2002.`
* **Câu viết hoàn chỉnh (Band 7.0):**
> *The two tables compare the average weekly working hours of full-time and part-time workers by gender in Greece, the Netherlands, and the UK compared to the European average in 2002.*

---
### PHẦN 2: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT OVERVIEW (2 câu)

#### Bước 1: Xác định 2 đặc điểm nổi bật nhất
* **Đặc điểm 1 (Full-time vs Part-time):** Lao động toàn thời gian làm việc nhiều giờ hơn hẳn lao động bán thời gian; nam giới full-time nhìn chung làm việc nhiều giờ hơn nữ giới full-time.
* **Đặc điểm 2 (Quốc gia làm nhiều nhất & Mức trung bình châu Âu):** Người lao động ở Hy Lạp (cả full-time lẫn part-time) luôn làm việc nhiều giờ nhất trong 3 nước, trong khi mức làm việc bán thời gian trung bình của toàn châu Âu lại cao hơn cả ba quốc gia khảo sát.

#### Bước 2: Ráp câu hoàn chỉnh (Band 7.0)
* **Câu 1 (So sánh hình thức & giới tính):** *Overall, full-time employees worked substantially longer hours than part-time staff, with full-time men generally working more hours than women.*
* **Câu 2 (Hy Lạp dẫn đầu):** *Additionally, Greece recorded the longest working hours in both employment categories, whereas the UK and the Netherlands showed very similar patterns.*

---
### PHẦN 3: CHIẾN THUẬT CHIA THÂN BÀI (PARAGRAPH DIVISION)

Ta chia thân bài trực tiếp theo **hai bảng số liệu**:
* **Body 1 (Bảng 1 - Lao động toàn thời gian - Full-time):**
  * Greece: Men 42.5 giờ, Women 39.9 giờ (cao nhất).
  * Netherlands: Đồng đều ở mức 38.0 giờ cho cả hai giới.
  * UK: Men 37.5 giờ, Women 37.0 giờ (thấp nhất).
  * Mức trung bình châu Âu: Men 40.4 giờ, Women 39.2 giờ.
* **Body 2 (Bảng 2 - Lao động bán thời gian - Part-time):**
  * Mức trung bình châu Âu cao vượt trội: Women 34.0 giờ, Men 32.0 giờ.
  * Greece: Men 30.0 giờ, Women 29.3 giờ.
  * Netherlands: Women 29.2 giờ, Men 28.3 giờ.
  * UK: Men 29.0 giờ, Women 28.0 giờ.

---
### PHẦN 4: KỸ THUẬT CHỌN ĐIỂM DỮ LIỆU ĐẮT GIÁ

* **Full-time:** Nam giới Hy Lạp làm việc nhiều nhất (42.5 giờ/tuần), là nhóm duy nhất vượt mốc 40 giờ trong 3 nước.
* **Hà Lan (Full-time):** Là nơi duy nhất có số giờ làm việc của nam và nữ bằng nhau chằn chặn ở mức 38.0 giờ.
* **Part-time:** Mức trung bình toàn châu Âu (32–34 giờ) cao hơn hẳn cả 3 quốc gia đơn lẻ (chỉ dao động từ 28–30 giờ).

---
### PHẦN 5: HƯỚNG DẪN VIẾT CHI TIẾT TỪNG BODY (BAND 7.0)

#### BODY 1: LAO ĐỘNG TOÀN THỜI GIAN (3-4 câu)
* **Câu 1 (Hy Lạp dẫn đầu full-time):** *In full-time employment, Greece recorded the longest hours, with Greek men working an average of 42.5 hours per week and women working 39.9 hours.*
* **Câu 2 (Hà Lan cân bằng giới):** *In the Netherlands, there was complete equality between genders, with both male and female full-timers working exactly 38.0 hours.*
* **Câu 3 (Vương quốc Anh thấp nhất):** *The UK reported the lowest full-time commitment, at 37.5 hours for men and 37.0 hours for women.*
* **Câu 4 (Mức trung bình châu Âu):** *By comparison, the European average stood higher than the UK and Netherlands, at 40.4 hours for males and 39.2 hours for females.*

#### BODY 2: LAO ĐỘNG BÁN THỜI GIAN (3 câu)
* **Câu 1 (Mức bình quân châu Âu cao nhất part-time):** *Turning to part-time work, the European average was notably higher than all three individual nations, standing at 34.0 hours for women and 32.0 hours for men.*
* **Câu 2 (Hy Lạp tiếp tục dẫn đầu):** *Among the three countries, Greece again had the highest figures, with part-time men working 30.0 hours and women working 29.3 hours.*
* **Câu 3 (Hà Lan và Anh bám sát):** *In the Netherlands and the UK, part-time working hours were slightly lower, ranging between 28.0 and 29.2 hours per week for both sexes.*

---
### PHẦN 6: TỔNG HỢP CÔNG THỨC FULL BÀI (CHEATSHEET)

1. **Intro:** `The two tables compare [weekly working hours of full-time and part-time employees] by gender in [Greece, Netherlands, UK, and European average] in [2002].`
2. **Overview:** `Overall, full-timers worked more than part-timers, and men worked slightly more than women. Greece had the longest hours in both categories.`
3. **Body 1 (Full-time):** `Greek men worked [42.5h] and women [39.9h]. Dutch employees tied at [38.0h]. The UK was lowest ([37.5h] and [37.0h]), compared to the EU average ([40.4h] and [39.2h]).`
4. **Body 2 (Part-time):** `The EU average was highest ([34h] women, [32h] men). Greece led the 3 countries at [~29-30h], while the Netherlands and UK hovered near [28-29h].`

---
### PHẦN 7: BÀI BÁO CÁO MẪU HOÀN CHỈNH (BAND 7.0 REPORT)

The two tables compare the average weekly working hours of full-time and part-time workers by gender in Greece, the Netherlands, and the UK compared to the European average in 2002.

Overall, full-time employees worked substantially longer hours than part-time staff, with full-time men generally working more hours than women. Additionally, Greece recorded the longest working hours in both employment categories, whereas the UK and the Netherlands showed very similar patterns.

In full-time employment, Greece recorded the longest hours, with Greek men working an average of 42.5 hours per week and women working 39.9 hours. In the Netherlands, there was complete equality between genders, with both male and female full-timers working exactly 38.0 hours. The UK reported the lowest full-time commitment, at 37.5 hours for men and 37.0 hours for women. By comparison, the European average stood higher than the UK and Netherlands, at 40.4 hours for males and 39.2 hours for females.

Turning to part-time work, the European average was notably higher than all three individual nations, standing at 34.0 hours for women and 32.0 hours for men. Among the three countries, Greece again had the highest figures, with part-time men working 30.0 hours and women working 29.3 hours. In the Netherlands and the UK, part-time working hours were slightly lower, ranging between 28.0 and 29.2 hours per week for both sexes.
